metadata.name: Highlight Review (高光回顾)
metadata.description: After every run, review where your power actually spiked: which floor, which room, and what you picked up. Works together with Item Weight Editor for custom item quality. Requires REPENTOGON. / 每局结束后回看战力到底在哪儿起飞的：哪一层、哪个房间、拿到了什么。配合 Item Weight Editor 可显示自定义道具评级。需要 REPENTOGON。
